name_en: Kanko yaki — wheat dough wrapped around seasonal fillings, pan-baked and steamed
summary_ja: 小麦粉の生地に山菜やあん、かぼちゃなど季節の具を包んで焼き蒸す相模原市津久井地域の郷土料理。稲作に向かない山間地の粉食文化から生まれ、雅楽の太鼓に似た形が名の由来と伝わる。
summary_en: A dish from the Tsukui area of Sagamihara City, wheat dough wrapped around seasonal fillings such as mountain vegetables, sweet bean paste or pumpkin, then pan-baked and steamed. Born of a wheat-based diet in mountains ill-suited to rice, its name is said to come from its resemblance to a drum used in court music.
source_title: かんこ焼き 神奈川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Maguro no kabuto-yaki — a whole tuna head slow-roasted in the oven
summary_ja: マグロの頭部をまるごとオーブンでじっくり焼き上げる三浦市三崎の名物料理。遠洋漁船の漁師たちが売り物にならない頭を船上で蒸し焼きにして食べたのが始まりとされ、希少な部位も味わえる。
summary_en: A specialty of Misaki in Miura City, a whole tuna head slow-roasted in the oven. Said to have begun with deep-sea fishermen steam-roasting unsellable heads aboard ship, it lets diners taste otherwise rare cuts.
source_title: マグロのかぶと焼き 神奈川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
